name: browser-use
headline: rg_history - Search Claude Code Memory
short_description: Search Claude Code's file system memory without vector databases or indexing. Ideal for operations teams needing quick, overhead-free agent discovery.
author: backnotprop

sections.overview:
rg_history is a skill for Claude Code that searches the agent's entire file system memory using ripgrep, eliminating the need for vector databases, indexing, or additional infrastructure. It provides fast, lightweight agent discovery by directly querying files stored locally. The skill is designed for operations teams and developers who need quick access to agent history and context without computational overhead. Installation requires ripgrep and a simple git clone into your Claude Code skills directory, after which the skill loads automatically.
Quickly locate past conversations and agent decisions in Claude Code history
Search agent memory for specific context without vector database latency
Operations teams auditing agent behavior and interactions
Debugging agent actions by searching file system memory traces
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/backnotprop/rg_history`
sections.usage:
```
Search my file system memory for all instances where [COMPANY] used [INDUSTRY] terminology in the past 30 days. Return the results in a structured format with timestamps and file paths.
```
